privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.subtitle: LobsterLog Electronic Logbook
privacy.section1Body: LobsterLog collects the fishing activity data you enter — trip dates, catch weights, gear counts, crew information, and port details — together with your fishing licence number, your licence holder's FIN, and your vessel number (VRN). Where your fishing area requires it, the position of your fishing effort is collected as well. This information is used to generate Department of Fisheries and Oceans (DFO) electronic logbook reports as required under the Fisheries Act.
privacy.section2Body:
Your logbook data is stored on this device. When you choose to submit an electronic report, that data is transmitted directly to DFO through their web service — this happens only when you tap "Send to DFO".

The app also keeps a record on this device of every report it sends to DFO. This is the record you must be able to produce for a fishery officer, and the law requires you to keep it for three years.

LobsterLog also offers an optional Cloud Backup, which is turned OFF by default. If you turn it on, a copy of your logbook data — including any crew names and fisher numbers you have saved — is stored on servers located in Canada, so you can restore it if you lose or replace your device. While Cloud Backup is on, your data is copied automatically as you save and send reports. You can turn it off at any time in your Captain Profile.
privacy.section3Body: Your DFO logbook data is never sold, shared, or disclosed for advertising, analytics, or any commercial purpose. It is shared only with DFO, as required for regulatory logbook compliance. If you turn on Cloud Backup, the backup is held by a cloud service provider on LobsterLog's behalf, on servers located in Canada. That provider does not use your data for any other purpose.
privacy.section4Body:
You can delete your account at any time — tap the gear icon, then Delete Account. Before anything is removed, the app saves you a copy of your transmission record — the reports you have sent, with DFO's confirmation for each — so you can keep it. Save that file somewhere safe: the law requires you to keep those records for three years, and once the deletion runs the app no longer holds them.

Deleting removes everything else in the app, including your cloud backup. It cannot recall reports already sent to DFO — those stay with DFO.

For any privacy questions, contact support@lobsterlog.com.
